essence: Narasimha's left-side hands bear a conch, sword, noose, and trident.
Narasimha's pairs of hands sequentially seize the enemy's knee and the surface of his head.
Narasimha tears apart Hiranyakashipu with his two lower hands.
Constant remembrance of Narasimha removes the fear of great death.
Narasimha removes fears of poison, disease, death, and enemies.
